title: Faà di Bruno is Taylor Composition
summary: We approach Faà di Bruno as a composition theorem for Taylor polynomials. For $C^k$ maps $φ: E \to F$ and $ψ: F \to G$ between Banach spaces, let $T^k_\ast(φ; x)$ denote the reduced Taylor polynomial of $φ$ at $x$, obtained by removing the constant term. We show that $$T^k_\ast(ψ\circ φ; x) = π_{\le k}\bigl(T^k_\ast(ψ; φ(x)) \circ T^k_\ast(φ; x)\bigr).$$ The proof is an elementary estimate of the Peano remainder and does not use partitions or combinatorial enumeration.
